# tests/data — Forth that a test LOADS, not a demo transcript

`tests/run.sh` runs every `tests/*.fs` on the host engine and diffs it against `tests/<name>.expected`.
That contract is for demo programs. The files here are different: they are loaded into a board session by
a test that then asks the board questions, so they have no transcript of their own.

* `lora_aes_vectors.fs` — the AES-128 vector for `tests/lora_aes.py`, generated by
  `tools/gen_aes_vectors.py` from the FIPS-197 key schedule plus `openssl`. It defines nothing: the cipher
  fills the prompt dictionary exactly (measured 1 328 B, 0 B free) and two helper definitions cost more
  than the 12 B that were left.
* `lora_aes_vector.json` — the same numbers for the Python side (round keys, plaintext, ciphertext).
* `sbox_alg.fs` — the computed-S-box experiment behind docs/31 Appendix E: correct for all 256 values,
  644 B of dictionary and 142 ms per byte, against a 256 B table. Kept because the measurement is the
  reason the table stays.
